shadows.name: document-cover
shadows.value: SwiftUI black 0.06 radius 2 x 0 y 1; black 0.08 radius 9 x 0 y 5
shadows.purpose: Actual fitted PDF page edges, including landscape covers; no outer placeholder shadow.

narrative.overview: Original passages, actual PDF pages and saved words establish its character, set on the app icon's world: washi paper, sumi ink, Mincho type, one matcha tint, shu for the bookmark and errors, sakura for highlights. Native navigation keeps the app familiar on iPhone.

rules.name: Content First
rules.body: Color identifies selection or action; it does not tint reading pages or ordinary library rows.

dos: Use real original text, source titles and PDF covers.
Inspect populated states, empty states, Chinese, light/dark appearance and accessibility sizes.
Preserve 44pt targets, system navigation, edge-swipe back and PDF text selection.
donts: Don't reintroduce repeated branding/title stacks, decorative green panels or giant primary pills.
Don't turn review screenshots or passing tests into a claim of user approval.
